contradictions.matters_because: Unchanged. The brief must say how a level is lost and how many slots the tray has; a reader skimming the Modes section could write that filling the tray loses the level.

contradictions.value_a: Frederick, 23 Sep, in the group chat where the reference level was shown: "we probably don't want the playable to trigger enrage. Just have the items fall back onto the board with no negative effect."
contradictions.value_b: Design page: when the tray fills "the tray clears and surviving monsters enrage"; Frederick's DM: "Write it for the game as it is today".
contradictions.matters_because: Unchanged. The persona view reports this group chat (named mpdm-brian.foster--frederick.stone--leonard.hayes--julia.lawson--robert-1) as not visible to Julia, with two members listed. If the run environment exposes it, the brief forks on whether a full tray enrages the zombies; if not, the requester holds a design wish the persona cannot find.
